tagline: International association representing the interests of European inland waterway transport stakeholders
hero_kpi_rationale: Direct measure of the association's engagement and international reach. The 2024 congress gathered 225 participants from 11 countries, reflecting IVR's influence in the European inland navigation sector.
company_description: IVR is an independent and neutral European association representing the interests of inland navigation, marine insurance, and vessel classification. It works on developing technical standards and preventing incidents in the sector.
